resumeText:
Vikram Malhotra | Gurugram | vikram.malhotra@example.com

EXPERIENCE

- Wrote Python scripts to replay market data and compare fills with exchange trade files.
- Ran and tuned the trading servers on Red Hat Linux with the infrastructure team.

Graduate Engineer, Aravalli Securities Tech, Gurugram (2021 - 2022)
